0222212112002010001111021 - ASI: 20

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  02 = 0 * 2
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  010 = 0 * 10
  021 = 0 * 21
  0011 = 00 * 11
  0222 = 02 * 22
  2002 = 20 * 02
  2121 = 21 * 21
  11021 = 11 * 021
  12002 = 1 * 2002
  0100011 = 010 * 0011
  02222121 = 0222 * 2121
  010001111021 = 0100011 * 11021
  0222212112002 = 02222121 * 12002
  0222212112002010001111021 = 0222212112002 * 010001111021
